column1: # mapping_set_title: SWAT4HCLS BioHackathon 2025: Gigwa to GA4GH VRS

# mapping_set_description: Mappings declared during the SWAT4HCLS 2025 BioHackathon between the Gigwa variant-annotation model (and the SO, GENO, SIO and annotation terms it reuses) and the GA4GH Variation Representation Specification. Transcribed from the project's curation spreadsheet; see mappings/README.md for the normalisations applied.

# comment: The ggw: namespace is a placeholder: Gigwa's annotation model had no published namespace IRI at the time of curation. SO/GENO/SIO CURIEs are normalised to the OBO and SIO forms used elsewhere in this repository. The curators worked against GA4GH VRS 1.2/1.3, so objects use the vrs1: prefix (VRS 1.3). Several targets here -- Genotype, Haplotype, SequenceInterval, ChromosomeLocation, Text, Residue, Feature, Gene, UtilityVariation -- were removed in VRS 2.0, which is the version vcf-core itself targets. See mappings/vcf-core-alignments.sssom.tsv for the vcf-core to VRS 2.0 spoke. Transcription verified against the source sheet on 2026-09-08: subject, predicate and object of every row match after the normalisations noted above.

column8: Source sheet wrote the object in lower camel case as ga4ghvrs:sequenceLocation.
CopyNumber existed in VRS 1.2 only; VRS 1.3 split it into CopyNumberCount and CopyNumberChange.
The source sheet recorded this mapping twice, as GENO:GENO_0000002 and geno:0000002; merged.
